chain.text: **Estate**: 18 ha; 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay and flint soils. **Output**: 62,000 bottles average; 48,000 in 2024 after May hail cut a fifth of western plots. **Certification**: Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026. **Export**: 41% of sales, mainly Belgium and Japan; Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l. **Failures**: 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; bulk loss €11,000; controllers now calibrated pre-harvest, tank 4 has second probe. **Failures**: 2023 label error sent 900 wrong-vintage bottles; all recalled; proofs need two signatures. **Rules**: No irrigation on western plots; 2021 trial lowered acidity below Japanese threshold. **Rules**: Harvest dates set from sugar and acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar. **Rules**: Tanks above 28°C during fermentation cooled within four hours. **Open**: Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed; no cost comparison. **Open**: Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years, yields down

**Estate**
18 ha: 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay/flint soils.

**Output**
62,000 bottles average; 48,000 in 2024 after May hail cut a fifth of western plots.

**Certification**
Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026.

**Export**
41% of sales, mainly Belgium and Japan; Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l.

**Failures**
2022: tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; €11,000 loss; now pre-harvest calibration, second probe.
2023: 900 wrong-vintage bottles recalled; proofs need two signatures.

**Rules**
No irrigation on western plots; 2021 trial lowered acidity below Japanese threshold.
Harvest dates set from sugar/acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar.
Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

**Open**
Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed; no cost comparison.
Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years, yields down.
